title: Best Cryptos to Help Beat the AI Job Takeover in 2027
description:
An enormous amount of jobs will very soon become obsolete. Companies blamed AI for more than 120,000 announced job cuts in the first nine months of 2026. Wages are what the AI takeover takes away. Ownership is what's left standing. And while paychecks still exist, that's the window to turn a paycheck into ownership.

So this video is about what to own. Four cryptos you can hold and stack so you can potentially retire early, and for each one the same question: why does owning this help you when the jobs go away?

I start with $ARB. It's my first time covering Arbitrum on this channel, so I explain it from zero. Then I get into Robinhood Chain, built on its technology, the SEC's new sandbox for tokenized US stocks, a few caveats, and the one number I judge it on. Then $KAS, my primary asset, and why proof of work money that nobody can print or freeze fits a world where AI takes the jobs. Then $TAO and owning a piece of the AI production itself instead of being replaced by it. And Toncoin, now officially called Gram ($GRAM), and the distribution that comes with Telegram.
